opportunities.situation: You are struggling with a school project. Maya is available to help. What will you do?

options.label: Ask Maya to work through the school project together.
options.contact_text: Alex asked me for help with a school project and we spent time on it together.
options.success_text: I asked Maya for help, and we worked out a difficult part of my school project.
options.failure_text: I asked Maya for help, and we tried together, but I was still stuck afterwards.

options.label: Try a different way to solve the project by yourself.
options.success_text: I tried a different approach and solved the difficult part myself.
options.failure_text: I tried working alone and remained stuck on the project.

opportunities.situation: A school group is preparing a project. You have an idea but are unsure how it will be received. What will you do?

options.label: Share the idea with Bea and ask what they think.
options.contact_text: Alex shared a school project idea with me and we discussed it.
options.success_text: I shared my idea with Bea, and we found a useful way to develop it.
options.failure_text: I shared my idea with Bea, but we could not find a way to use it for the project.

options.label: Write a draft before sharing anything.
options.success_text: I worked privately and completed a useful draft of my idea.
options.failure_text: I tried drafting my idea but did not get it into a usable form.

new_goal.description: Prepare and deliver a community project presentation.

opportunities.situation: You want to finish your community presentation. You have time today to prepare. What will you do next?

options.label: Rehearse the presentation with Maya.
options.contact_text: I spent time listening to Alex rehearse a community presentation.
options.success_text: I rehearsed with Maya and made concrete progress on my presentation.
options.failure_text: Maya and I tried a rehearsal, but I still struggled with the opening.

options.label: Work alone on revising the presentation notes.
options.success_text: I revised my notes and completed another section of the presentation.
options.failure_text: I worked on my notes but did not finish a usable section today.
